# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is considered fat by her classmates, but she possesses a malicious smile. She is known for wearing flounces on all her dresses.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Josie is vain, boastful, and frequently malicious toward her peers. She has a reputation for cheating in school and often displays an unpleasant, spiteful temper. She lacks imagination and holds herself above others, frequently making sarcastic or envious remarks.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Traits

- Vain  <sub>[v1 c30 P18](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0018)</sub>
- Malicious  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>
- Cheater  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- Lacks imagination  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- Snobbish  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- Walking board fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- Attending college for education's sake rather than to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Josie attends the Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her classmates under Mr. Phillips and later Miss Stacy. She frequently clashes with Anne due to her malicious nature, such as peeping in her book during a spelling class or gloating over punishments. At Diana Barry's party, Josie dares Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, which results in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Later, Josie joins the Queen's Academy preparation class, though she boasts that she only goes for education's sake since she does not need to earn a living. She passes the entrance exams and attends Queen's Academy, where she earns a Second Class teacher's license.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)_
